scopeReview: CED CHA-3.C.1 non-motion applied rates, with context interpretation, derivative selection, signs, scaling and units. Population, temperature, cost, spatial density, geometry, height, concentration, power and production examples. Finite-table rates remain estimates.
varietyReview: Seven distinct numerical models plus conceptual comparisons of geometric input rates, concentration height/rate, rising totals with falling rates and absolute versus percentage growth. Original energy table included.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
